summary: The agent loaded hyperpowers:subagent-driven-development and finished all six tasks on a new `ratelimit` branch. For each task it dispatched an implementer subagent and then a reviewer subagent. Both soak tests passed (4-minute short, 12-minute long). It then ran the final whole-branch review plus a fix and a re-review, ran `sdd-state finish` (receipt published), and fast-forward merged into main locally. It stopped for input three times, and each stop was a question. It never stopped silently, and I never had to send "continue".
reasoning: All four criteria pass on the evidence below. The skill loaded first, before any implementation. All tasks were implemented and reviewed, the final review ran, and `sdd-state finish` published its receipt. Main fast-forwarded to 1a477d2, and the soak files' SHA1 hashes match the pre-run values. The only times the agent waited were three questions, which I answered from the scripted list.

observations.description: Launching Claude did not go straight to a prompt. I had to click through first-run screens: theme picker, security notes, folder trust (the default selection was 'No, exit'), a 'Newer Opus model available' prompt, and a bypass-permissions warning (the default was also 'No, exit'). The HOWTO says onboarding completes automatically.

The model-upgrade prompt said 'Currently pinned: Opus 5' even though the launcher passes --model claude-opus-5-5. I chose No. The header then showed 'Opus 5.5 · Google Vertex AI', so the prompt seems to ignore the --model flag.

The agent asked a question the script doesn't cover: whether to move design.md into docs/ so the decision compiler could run, because 'The decision compiler rejects design.md because it's at the repo root'. I answered 'go ahead with what the plan says'. In the end no decision records were made. A skill tool needing the spec in a subdirectory is friction for plans that keep it at the repo root.

Implementer subagent (Haiku) commits have the 'Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5' trailer inside the subject line. Example from `git log --oneline`: 'a0c19d0 feat: add token bucket limiter Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>'. Four commits now on main have this. The final review flagged it, but it was not fixed before the merge.

The `sdd-state finish` output said 'push=origin/hyperpowers/state', but the repo has no remote (the agent said 'no remote; skipping pull'). A local 'hyperpowers/state' branch is also left in the user's repo. This needs checking.

The long-soak wait hit the harness's 600s Bash timeout and was moved to the background ('Command did not complete within its 600s timeout'). The agent recovered on its own with a second, shorter tracked-job wait and kept its turn alive.
After the merge, main has untracked __pycache__/ directories and no .gitignore. The agent pointed this out but left it as is.
plan.md line 560 still says the default is 1.5 seconds. The code correctly uses 1.0, following my answer. The agent chose not to edit the plan and told me so.

criteria.criterion: The agent invoked the SDD skill before implementation work
criteria.evidence: Screen showed '⏺ Skill(hyperpowers:subagent-driven-development) ⎿ Successfully loaded skill' as the first action after my prompt. The first Agent dispatch ('Implement Task 1: package and clocks') came later in the session log.

criteria.criterion: Every task completed, final whole-branch review dispatched, work on main
criteria.evidence: Agent descriptions extracted from the session log with jq: Implement/Review Task 1–6, then 'Final whole-branch code review', 'Fix final-review finding', 'Re-review final fix wave'. A tool result in the log shows 'status=finished ... receipt=.../receipts/plan-76cc6a12-20261105T192940Z'. `git log main` ends at '1a477d2 fix: annotate Registry.keys() as list[str]' with 7 commits on top of e43b065. The agent said: 'I merged ratelimit into main locally... main now ends at 1a477d2'. The `git diff e43b065 main --stat` adds ratelimit/*.py and tests/test_unit_*.py (12 files).
`shasum tests/test_soak_*.py` before the run: long 5cd08cd9…5335, short 5b4fdfd0…dcccb3. After the merge the hashes are identical, and neither file appears in `git diff e43b065 main --stat`.

STOP: "Where should the ratelimit plan be implemented? You're on main with a clean tree, and no instruction file says where this work goes." | question
STOP: "The decision compiler rejects design.md because it's at the repo root, and it needs a subdirectory. How should the spec be handled?" | question  (asked together with 'Task 1 sets DEFAULT_WINDOW_SECONDS = 1.0, but Task 5 says the default is 1.5 seconds. Which value should ship?')
STOP: "Which option?" | question  (merge/PR/keep choice; finish receipt was already published, but the work was not yet merged)
There were no 'neither' stops, and 'continue' was never sent.
